Label: com.ravynos.firefoxtest
ProgramArguments: echo '[fftest] shell='$$; echo '[fftest] start'; mkdir -p /var/tmp/ff; cd /var/tmp/ff; ( sleep 45; echo '[fftest] ps@45s:'; ps -ax -o pid,stat,comm | grep -E 'firefox|runas' ) & echo '[fftest] create profile'; /usr/local/compat/runas -t 90 99 99 /Applications/Firefox.app/Contents/MacOS/firefox -CreateProfile 'ravyntest /var/tmp/ff/profile' 2>&1 & ffpid=$!; echo '[fftest] ff pid='$ffpid; ( sleep 60; echo '[fftest] tdump2:'; /usr/local/compat/tdump $ffpid 2>&1 ) & ( sleep 66; echo '[fftest] tsample2:'; /usr/local/compat/tsample $ffpid 2>&1 ) & ( sleep 1; echo '[fftest] images:'; /usr/local/compat/tsample -i $ffpid 2>&1 ) & ( sleep 3; echo '[fftest] images3:'; /usr/local/compat/tsample -i $ffpid 2>&1 ) & ( sleep 6; echo '[fftest] images6:'; /usr/local/compat/tsample -i $ffpid 2>&1 ) & ( sleep 60; echo '[fftest] ls ff:'; ls -la /var/tmp/ff /var/tmp/ff/profile 2>&1 ) & wait $ffpid; echo '[fftest] create rc='$?
